keys.what: starts or stops all sequencer slots (euclid, dots; oracle and peal too)

shift + G, A, B, C, D, E (the last six white keys)

keys.what: USB out page (master, or master + the four tape tracks)

keys.keys: orange encoder press (op1r calls it red)

keys.what: removes the marker under the cursor; the same press as Oblique Strategies' card
jumps to the next / previous marker (stock: the record level)

shows a random Oblique Strategies card; while it shows, any key closes it and that press does nothing else. On top of op1r it runs before op1r's key handling, so it would take op1r's shift + red on the dots and euclid screens if that means the red encoder press (not checked)
shows a random Oblique Strategies card in the clock's place; shift + help again switches card / clock (since op1r 21). The standalone Oblique Strategies mod uses shift + orange encoder press instead

keys.keys: hold a note key (shift + key latches)
keys.where: any screen, while oracle or peal is the sequencer
keys.what: oracle plays transposed to the key; peal rings the held keys (3–8) as bells, like the stock sequencers

midi.what: the keys, as in the OP-1's own CTRL mode (key code + 5)
mixer volume, pan and mute per track, tape input
